faqs.q: What is a 1-13/16 in API 6A gate valve rated 15,000 psi used for?
faqs.a: A 1-13/16 in API 6A gate valve rated 15,000 psi (15K class) isolates flow on wellheads, trees and manifolds. It is a full-bore, handwheel-operated gate valve with a hydraulic actuator available on request, supplied new to the PSL, PR, material class and temperature class you specify.

faqs.q: What do PSL, PR and material class mean on a 1-13/16 in 15K API 6A gate valve?
faqs.a: On the 1-13/16 in 15,000 psi valve, PSL (1 to 4) sets the inspection, testing and traceability level, PR1 or PR2 sets the design-validation level, and material class (AA to HH) sets the body and trim chemistry. Units we have seen at this size and rating are marked PSL 3, PR2 and material class EE-1.5. See [reading an API 6A nameplate](/blog/api-6a-nameplate-markings).

faqs.q: Which ring gasket does a 1-13/16 in 15K API 6A flanged gate valve take?
faqs.a: The 1-13/16 in 15K flange is API 6BX flanged, and it takes a BX-151 ring gasket. Order the ring gaskets with the valve if you need them, and use a new ring each time the flange is made up.

faqs.q: Should I choose the 1-13/16 in 15,000 psi gate valve or the 2-1/16 in at the same 15K rating?
faqs.a: Choose the 1-13/16 in if your line bore is 1-13/16 in; match the valve bore to the line so tools and flow pass through. The 2-1/16 in gate valve at 15,000 psi is a different bore with its own flange and ring, so see the [2-1/16 in 15,000 psi gate valve](/p/api-6a-gate-valve-2-1-16-inch-15000-psi) for that size.

faqs.q: What are the working pressure and test pressure of a 1-13/16 in 15K API 6A gate valve?

faqs.q: Which material class do I need on a 1-13/16 in 15,000 psi API 6A gate valve for sour service?
